content.p1: Transform your text into proper sentence case format with our free online sentence case converter. This tool automatically capitalizes the first letter of each sentence while converting the rest to lowercase, ensuring your text follows standard grammatical rules. It is perfect for cleaning up technical documentation, emails, and any long-form writing where capitalization consistency is key.

faq.a1: Sentence case is a capitalization style where only the first letter of the first word in a sentence is capitalized, along with proper nouns.
faq.q2: Does this tool capitalize the word "I"?
faq.a2: Yes, our intelligent logic recognizes "i" as a pronoun and capitalizes it appropriately throughout your text.
faq.q3: Is there a limit to how much text I can convert?
faq.a3: No, you can process thousands of words at once effortlessly.
faq.q4: Where can I use this tool?
faq.a4: It works on any text—from website content and emails to legal documents and code comments.
faq.a5: Absolutely. All processing occurs locally in your browser via JavaScript, so your raw text is never transmitted to any server.
